comment: Edge-case category labels covered by this task's hidden tests. Each label must have a corresponding predicate file under coverage_predicates/<label>.js. The label_descriptions field is the only context a blind predicate-authoring subagent sees.

label_descriptions.empty-input: The input is the empty string. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises empty-string input.
label_descriptions.whitespace-only: The input contains only whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, etc.). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises whitespace-only input.
label_descriptions.consecutive-separators: The input contains adjacent characters that all become hyphens (e.g. multiple spaces in a row, mixed punctuation back-to-back). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises consecutive-separator input.
label_descriptions.leading-trailing-separators: The input begins or ends with characters that become hyphens. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises leading or trailing separator input.
label_descriptions.mixed-case: The input contains both uppercase and lowercase letters. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises mixed-case input.
label_descriptions.punctuation: The input contains common punctuation (commas, exclamation marks, ampersands, etc.). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises punctuated input.
label_descriptions.unicode-non-ascii: The input contains characters outside the ASCII letter/digit range (accented letters, CJK, emoji). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that exercises non-ASCII input.
